body.name: Common-anchor transport map and derivative
body.construction: For \(x\in\mathbb R^{|\Omega_n|}\), set \[(F_n(x))_{I_bQ_b}=x_{I_bP_{0,n}}\{\Pi_r(x_{C_{0,n}P_{0,n}})\}^{\dagger}x_{C_{0,n}Q_b},\qquad b\in\mathcal B_n.\] For a rank-\(r\) matrix \(B=USV^{\top}\), put \(D\Pi_{r,B}[H]=UU^{\top}H+HVV^{\top}-UU^{\top}HVV^{\top}\). For \(f(A,B,C)=A\{\Pi_r(B)\}^{\dagger}C\), define \(Df_{A,B,C}[H_1,H_2,H_3]=H_1B^{\dagger}C+A\,D(B^{\dagger})[D\Pi_{r,B}[H_2]]C+AB^{\dagger}H_3\), where \[D(B^{\dagger})[H]=-B^{\dagger}HB^{\dagger}+B^{\dagger}B^{\dagger\top}H^{\top}(I-BB^{\dagger})+(I-B^{\dagger}B)H^{\top}B^{\dagger\top}B^{\dagger}.\] On the stable branch, assemble the unique coordinate Jacobian \(\widehat J_n=DF_n(\widetilde X_{\Omega_n})\in\mathbb R^{|W_n|\times|\Omega_n|}\) by lexicographic ordering of observed and missing cells.
